I've only just started this site, so I welcome comments and any other items of bullshit I can include — so we can avoid it, make our world a better place, and change the nonsense companies imposing and feeding us their bullshit.

Please send supporting information and names that show the problem is real and damaging, and I'll reference them on the page.

Send a message

This form is not connected to a mailbox yet. The site is being built and tested before it goes live, so sending it does not deliver anything. Once the site is published this will be wired to a real inbox — or, if you prefer, this section will be replaced with a plain email address you can copy.

Prefer plain email?

Once the site is live, messages can come to engineerone500@hotmail.co.uk. Until then, use the form above so the layout gets tested properly.

What's most useful to send

  • A link to the official source — a regulator's page, a published report, a company's own terms.
  • Which page you think needs changing, and what is wrong with it.
  • For a correction: what the accurate information is, and where you found it.
